parties.petitioner: Authorised Officer State Bank Of India

summary: Forfeiture of earnest money after auction; delay in payment citing DRT proceedings; power under SARFAESI Act; standard: non-arbitrariness of forfeiture order; High Court allowed refund claiming no loss to Bank as asset sold at same price later; SC reversed; forfeiture valid due to respondent's default after extended deadline; Bank permitted to retain earnest money as per Rules; pendency of DRT proceedings not justified delay beyond status quo order; no concession by Bank counsel in HC.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; forfeiture upheld; refund direction quashed.
